summary: Bidirectional alignment fails after full forward/reverse walks. Instruction-stated HTTP API merge parity is never exercised (no cc-api usage; test_f2p_api_merge_requires_iam is CLI-only). Verifier also grades undocumented metrics and dispatch-webhooks sink/status shapes, while binding audit allow-path and several published merge/outbox obligations remain only partially covered.

evidence.observation: Two paragraphs: incident symptoms (Alice MFA/main, quorum/FF, exactly-once deliver, denied audit, outbox enqueue, weaker HTTP API merge) plus binding pointer to control-plane-contract.md for IAM/quorum/FF/deliver/event_id/audit/outbox; drive ccctl and cc-api.

Published CLI command list is clone/push/pr/approve/merge/deliver only; IAM/conditions; quorum/FF/no merge commit; event_id preimage and journal key order; outbox enqueue and failed-row retry; audit every allow and deny. HTTP headers named but no HTTP routes/schemas. metrics and dispatch-webhooks absent from CLI list.

35 pytest behaviors via ccctl only; zero cc-api/HTTP calls. Includes test_p2p_metrics_command and test_f2p_dispatch_marks_outbox_attempt asserting sink/delivered; test_f2p_api_merge_requires_iam uses CLI merge.
Solver-visible HTTP surface includes POST .../merge with broken starter skipping MergePullRequestByFastForward; not referenced by any verifier case.
Binary exposes metrics and dispatch-webhooks beyond the contract CLI list; dispatch always injects an in-memory sink in the response body.
Classification-only map; used to label F2P/P2P ownership, not as a requirement source.
Ops evidence restating symptoms; not a second acceptance checklist.
Overnight log names decision-drop, duplicate deliver, outbox skip, API merge without IAM, quorum required=1, two-parent merge — supports current-state claims; mild diagnosis detail.
Material phantom or untested requirement, grading ambiguity, or API/docs boundary defect forces REVISE; exhaustive walks required before verdict.
Instruction owns material ask; delegated contracts may hold protocol detail but must not leave graded requirements undiscoverable or hide goals as prompt extension.

findings.criterion: Instruction requires HTTP API merge path parity with CLI IAM; verifier never drives cc-api and test_f2p_api_merge_requires_iam only exercises CLI merge.
findings.why_it_matters: A CLI-only repair can score 1 while leaving the stated weaker HTTP merge path broken; material req-gap against an explicit instruction objective.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add a behavioral HTTP merge denial/allow case via cc-api (or drop the HTTP API merge requirement from the solver-visible ask).
findings.regression_risk: Medium — new API fixture may need stable listen/port handling in verifier image.

findings.criterion: test_p2p_metrics_command grades metrics JSON keys (audit, journal_lines) that are absent from instruction.md and the binding contract CLI/output surface.
findings.why_it_matters: Phantom-spec: solvers can fail grading for an undeclared operator surface, or pass without knowing metrics is required.
findings.minimal_remediation: Remove the metrics assertion, or publish metrics as a binding CLI/API obligation with schema.

findings.criterion: test_f2p_dispatch_marks_outbox_attempt grades dispatch-webhooks plus private response fields (sink truthy, status delivered) not present in the published CLI contract; contract only states enqueue and failed-row retry.
findings.why_it_matters: Private return-value/command contract; CLI always injects an in-memory sink, so sink asserts are not an independently discoverable public interface.
findings.minimal_remediation: Document dispatch-webhooks and outbox attempt/status schema in the binding contract, and assert durable outbox state without requiring sink; or narrow the test to enqueue-only behaviors already published.
findings.regression_risk: Medium — tightening schema may fail alternate correct dispatch UIs.

findings.criterion: Binding contract requires every authorize decision (allow and deny) to append audit.jsonl; tests only assert denied rows.
findings.why_it_matters: Allow-path audit omission can still pass while violating the binding audit append contract referenced by instruction.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add an allow-path audit assertion after a successful authorize, or narrow the binding sentence to denied decisions if that is the true contract.

findings.criterion: Instruction tells solvers to use cc-api for the weaker HTTP merge path, but the binding contract publishes only HTTP identity headers—no routes, methods, or merge request/response schema.
findings.why_it_matters: Grading-relevant ambiguity: fair discovery of the HTTP merge obligation depends on source spelunking rather than the named binding contract.
findings.minimal_remediation: Extend control-plane-contract.md with the graded HTTP merge (and related) routes/headers/schemas, or stop requiring cc-api in instruction.
findings.regression_risk: Low if documentation-only; higher if new graded fields are over-specified.

findings.criterion: Missing approval rule => NO_APPROVAL_RULE is published under Approvals and merge but never asserted.
findings.why_it_matters: Wrong missing-rule handling can ship without failing grading; less central than quorum/FF but still a published merge-path failure mode.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add a missing-rule merge denial case, or remove NO_APPROVAL_RULE from the binding contract if out of scope.

findings.criterion: Outbox 'failed rows may be retried until max attempts' is not covered; dispatch test only marks a pending row delivered on first attempt.
findings.why_it_matters: Max-attempt/retry ladder bugs would not fail current tests; softened by 'may' wording.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional failed-then-retry / max-attempt fixture once dispatch is properly contracted.

findings.criterion: platform-incident.log names concrete defect mechanisms (decision-drop path, API merge without IAM check) that map closely to repair targets.
findings.why_it_matters: Mild implementation-diagnosis leakage in evidence; still plausible as overnight ops log and not a prompt-extension checklist.
findings.minimal_remediation: Softened symptom-only wording in the incident log if leakage must be reduced.

findings.criterion: Deliver success body fields such as delivered[] are graded but not fully schema-specified in the binding contract (event_id/duplicate/journal keys are).
findings.why_it_matters: Alternate but correct stdout shapes could fail; primary event_id/journal obligations are still discoverable.
findings.minimal_remediation: Publish deliver success JSON schema beside the existing push/approve/merge schemas.
